title: Signature Thermal Watch — Watch concept
description: The Signature Thermal Watch is Manon's original thermal sentinel: it shows every core's temperature as distance-to-danger, not as a bare number. Seventy-two degrees means nothing; twenty-eight degrees of headroom means everything.

title: Signature Thermal Watch — Watch at first boot
description: The Watch needs no install and learns the machine's idle personality in its first hour — what 'normal' means for this cooler, this case, this room. Every later reading is judged against that personal baseline, not a generic chart.
